scale_boxes: scale bounding boxes to target image sizes for owlv2 object detection
pad_images: pad torch tensor images to square dimensions with zero fill
resize_image_torch: resize a torch tensor image with anti-aliasing for owlv2 preprocessing
resize_image_numpy: resize a numpy array image with scipy gaussian filtering for owlv2 preprocessing
preprocess_images_torch: preprocess a batch of torch images with rescale, pad, resize, and normalize
